title: Part-Time Credit Controller - Fully Remote
description:
We are seeking an experienced Credit Controller for a UK-based private mental health and forensic services company, in a fully remote role where you will to manage money owed to the business and be responsible for collecting outstanding debts from their clients.

Our client provides psychological and psychiatric expert witness assessments to solicitors and local authorities in criminal and family court proceedings, alongside educational psychology services for local authorities and schools.

About the role
As Credit Controller, you will deal mainly the solicitors and local authorities who instruct their expert witness service, resolving invoice and payment queries, and reporting on the status of key accounts. Some debts are long-dated, so persistence and good working relationships with solicitors' and local authority finance teams are essential. You will work directly with the Managing Director and, where needed, support our Management Accountant with month-end processes.

Key responsibilities:
- Working closely with the Managing Director, advising and updating on all matters relating to credit control and the debtor position
- Chasing overdue debts by phone and email, with a particular focus on accounts over 90 and 120 days, in line with agreed targets
- Managing purchase orders, supplier portal invoice submissions and remittance matching for local authority clients where required
- Accurately logging all client communication in our CRM system (Zoho)
- Recording payments received in our accounting system (Zoho Books) and allocating them accurately to client accounts
- Liaising with our accounts administrator to ensure invoices, client statements and credit notes for clients and associates are processed correctly
- Resolving payment and invoice queries promptly, liaising with colleagues in other departments to resolve them within agreed timeframes
- Monitoring client accounts and highlighting risks promptly to the Managing Director
- Supporting the Management Accountant with month-end processes, reporting and reconciliations to a high degree of accuracy, where required
- Escalating unpaid debts in line with agreed procedures, including issuing letters before action and claiming statutory late payment interest where appropriate
- Agreeing payment plans with clients where appropriate
- Achieving agreed targets for debtor days and overall debt value, and reporting regularly on performance against them

The rewards
As a progressive, responsible company, they are committed to supporting employees' work-life balance. The role of Credit Controller is a fully remote position and the hours of work are 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with flexible working hours within reason.
- The salary on offer is £30,000 to £32,000 per annum FTE, depending on experience (£15,000-£16,000 actual for 0.5 FTE)
- 25 days paid holiday plus bank holidays, pro rata
- Company pension scheme
- 24-hour Employee Assistance Programme
- Occasional company social events

As a progressive and responsible employer, the Company is committed to supporting a healthy work life balance and promoting employee wellbeing.

Essential skills and experience:
- Proven experience in a credit control or accounts receivable role
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting software (Zoho Books experience an advantage)
- Current working knowledge of credit control procedures and best practice

Person Specification
It would be an advantage if you have experience of credit control with solicitors, local authorities or other public sector clients. You must also have / be:
- Calm, tactful and professional, with an excellent telephone manner
- Able to work to targets and demonstrate results
- Strong interpersonal skills, able to build good relationships with clients and colleagues at all levels
- Organised and methodical, with strong numeracy, attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy
- Self-motivated and tenacious, able to work independently and prioritise under pressure
- Able to handle confidential information sensitively

An AAT or similar finance qualification, or training in bookkeeping or accounts would be desirable.

How to Apply
Please note that eRecruitSmart is advertising the role of Credit Controller on behalf of the Hiring Company and your CV will be sent to the Hiring Manager who is responsible for the vacancy that you have applied to. Please only apply if you consent to these terms.

You must reside in and have eligibility to work in the UK. Please note, only suitable applicants will be contacted. If your address and contact details are not on your CV, you will not be considered.

We look forward to hearing from you!
